agent.name: Gap Detection Agent
agent.description: Analyses structured requirements to identify gaps, ambiguities, missing information, and implied but unstated requirements. Returns a gap report with severity, category, and recommended resolution per item.

behaviour._blocking_note: critical and high gaps are returned to calling agent or GenWiz as blocking — should be resolved before backlog generation

project_context._note: domain + market used by regulatory_gap_detection to load checklist. Skill skips gracefully if absent.

gap_report.description: One item per gap identified. Each item has req_id_ref, gap_type, severity, description, and recommendation.

item_schema.req_id_ref: REQ-### from PL-01 or null if implied requirement with no REQ
item_schema.description: Plain English description of the gap
item_schema.recommendation: Specific action to resolve the gap
item_schema.regulation_ref: string or null — specific article/standard reference (only for regulatory_non_compliance gaps)

gap_summary.description: Aggregated summary of all gaps found.

gap_analysis.description: Cross-references structured requirements against the business case to identify missing coverage, ambiguous language, and implied but unstated requirements.

ambiguity_detection.description: Scans each requirement for vague language, unmeasurable criteria, missing actors, and missing business value statements.

conflict_detection.description: Checks for requirements that contradict each other or that conflict with scope_boundaries.

auto_resolution._note: Deferred. Would auto-generate missing acceptance criteria for low-severity gaps.

regulatory_gap_detection.description: Reads project_context.domain + project_context.market, loads a regulatory checklist, and checks each requirement against mandatory clauses. Flags missing coverage with specific article/standard references.

gap_classifier.description: Classifies each identified gap by type and severity using gap_categories and severity_levels from behaviour.

freeform_extraction._note: Free-form documents (docx/pdf/html) are parsed for text and then an LLM call extracts structured fields. No fixed template required.

git_reader._note: Disabled — all input comes from shared_folder. Kept for backward compatibility with agent init code.
